name: notion-tasks
description: A /board pane of your Notion tasks (one click hands a task to Claude) and /devlog to post a session devlog to Notion

dataSource.title: Notion tasks data source
dataSource.description: The collection:// URL of the Notion database that holds your tasks (find it with notion-search, or open the database and copy its data source URL).

writeBack.title: Write status back to Notion
writeBack.description: Starting a task sets Status to In progress; the Done button sets it to Done. Off: the pane never writes to Notion.

devlogPage.title: Notion devlog page
devlogPage.description: Page id or URL of the Notion page that /devlog appends entries to.
